content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **On-Chain Crypto Payments**: Bangladeshi creators use NOWPayments to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with 0.5% fees. No buyer accounts required. 2. **Decentralized Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensure storefronts remain live without centralized takedown risks. 3. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing without server dependencies. 4. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets store transactions without monthly SaaS fees. 5. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver products instantly post-payment. 6. **Email Infrastructure**: Custom SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations ensure delivery of order confirmations. 7. **Currency Agnostic Pricing**: Pricing in stablecoins (USDT, USDC) eliminates local currency volatility risks.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

On-chain payments remove intermediaries that block Bangladeshi creators. Decentralized hosting means no single entity can shut down your store. Backend logic automates processes without recurring costs. Order storage in owned databases prevents vendor lock-in. File delivery systems ensure instant product access. Email configurations guarantee communication reliability. Stablecoin pricing protects revenue from taka fluctuations. Together, these components form a stack where every layer is controlled by the creator, not rented from a platform. This isn't just payment acceptance—it's infrastructure sovereignty.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Most creators over-rely on centralized crypto exchanges for payments, risking account freezes. Others neglect email deliverability, causing order confirmations to land in spam. Many fail to price in stablecoins, exposing earnings to currency devaluation. The biggest mistake? Building on platforms they don't own. Bangladeshi creators who succeed treat their stack as a product itself—every component is selected for permanence, not convenience. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints for these systems, ensuring no critical layer is overlooked.
On-chain payments remove geographic payment barriers entirely.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with on-chain payments—without this, nothing else matters. Next, deploy decentralized hosting to ensure your storefront is untouchable. Implement backend logic to automate order processing. Add order storage to track transactions. Configure file delivery for instant product access. Set up email infrastructure to maintain customer communication. Finally, price in stablecoins to protect earnings. Each step builds on the last, creating a stack where every component reinforces sovereignty. The Complete Builder Kit provides step-by-step guides for this sequence.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

Deploying this stack requires no coding expertise but demands strategic assembly. Start with GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto acceptance. Use Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC through Cloudflare. Price products in USDT. Test end-to-end before launching. The Complete Builder Kit includes all templates and blueprints to deploy this stack in 48 hours. Bangladeshi creators who use this architecture own their infrastructure—no platform can revoke access.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can Bangladeshi creators use Stripe or PayPal?

No. Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in Bangladesh due to regulatory restrictions. On-chain crypto payments via NOWPayments provide a sovereign alternative with 0.5% fees and no buyer accounts required.
Why is decentralized hosting important?

Decentralized hosting on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures your storefront cannot be taken down by a single entity. It's critical for creators in regions with internet censorship or platform restrictions.
What’s the advantage of pricing in stablecoins?
Pricing in stablecoins like USDT or USDC protects earnings from local currency volatility. Bangladeshi creators avoid taka devaluation risks by transacting in globally stable assets.
How does email infrastructure impact sales?
Proper SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations ensure order confirmations reach customers' inboxes, not spam folders. Reliable communication is essential for maintaining trust and completing transactions.
Why should creators own their infrastructure?

Owning your infrastructure means no platform can revoke access or impose fees. Bangladeshi creators who deploy sovereign stacks control every layer of their commerce operations, from payment to delivery.
